references.text: The prediction that locusts would cover the surface of the earth, now fulfilled in verse 15.
The Lord's command to Moses to stretch out his hand to bring locusts over Egypt.
Locusts devouring the harvest are mentioned as a curse for disobedience to the Lord.
The psalmist recalls how God gave their crops to locusts and their labor to swarms of insects.
The psalmist describes how the locusts came and ate up all the green in the land.
Joel describes a similar plague of locusts that devours everything.
The Lord promises to restore what the locusts have eaten.
Revelation describes locusts coming from the smoke and given power like scorpions on the earth.
The hail plague (9:25) creates the void that the locusts (10:15) then fill with complete destruction.
Psalm 105:35 is a historical summary of the locust plague described in Exodus 10.
Theological contrast: The enemy's destruction of Israel's crops versus God's judgment on Egypt's crops.
